new: The output page and the cameras have addresses of their own: while the output page runs the address ends in &output, while the preview camera or camera mode runs it ends in &camera.
A reload starts again only what the address says: a plain room address (#s=XYZ) always reloads as a plain page, never in camera mode (before, the tab remembered it).
A link with &camera on a computer opened afresh shows its Start page; reloading that address starts the preview camera by itself.
test: Start the output page from the Shared dialog: the address gets &output; reload: it comes back; Stop: the address loses it; reload: a plain page.
The same with the preview camera (&camera), and on an Android phone with camera mode (a reload shows its Start the camera page).
untested: Camera mode on a real phone with the new address; bookmarks of the new addresses in Safari.
